title: Close the remaining release-policy review gaps
description: Close the remaining release-policy review gaps
no_spec_change_rationale: The CLI v3 contract already requires strict release provenance and SpecSync lifecycle enforcement; these fixes close enforcement and documentation gaps without changing the public Rune CLI
acceptance_criteria: SpecSync policy files remain meaningful when generated change artifacts are ignored; both publish jobs reject tags outside vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH before resolving provenance; release documentation signs and pushes merge-commit attestation before trust verification; regression coverage and all release/trust gates pass
